notes: Physics impact cue rules (mw-e03.40): a physics object (crate, barrel, bottle, debris) that lands, tumbles or is knocked into something plays its own material's impact set (sfx-impact-<class>, from the material's impactSound), louder the more energy the impact had: a crate dropped from head height is near full volume, a nudge or a tumble step sits well below it. Only impacts at or above the physics layer's minimum closing speed (1 m/s) are events at all, and a short per-object cooldown keeps a bouncing or rolling object from machine-gunning. Material-pair sets (wood on stone, glass on metal) can add more specific rules on top by matching entity and other; final assets arrive through the placeholder pack (e28.2) and the SFX asset groups.
